textTemplates.text:
{!Get_Account_Details.WCF_Organizational_Name__c} · A few items need updating before your application can move ahead.

A few updates needed.

Application {!$Record.Name}- {!$Record.Organization_Name__c}

 

Hi {!$Record.Account.Name},

Thank you for your application for {!$Record.Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c}. We have checked it for completeness, and a few items are missing or need correcting before it can go to review. Your application has not been rejected.

What we need

What we need: {!Get_Proposal_Review.Consolidated_Return_Comments__c}

Sign in, update the items listed above, and submit your application again by {!$Record.Due_Date_for_Resubmission__c}. Everything else you entered is saved, so you only need to change these items.

If we do not hear from you, we will send you a reminder after 30 days. If we still have not heard from you 100 days from now, we will close the application, and you would be welcome to apply again.

In case of any queries, please write to us at grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org

Update your application

Kind Regards,
{!$Record.WG_Validator_Name__c}
Wadhwani Grants, application checks

Wadhwani Grants, the grant-making arm of the Wadhwani Foundation.

Questions? Just reply to this email; it reaches me and the Wadhwani Grants team at grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org.

textTemplates.name: Reviewer_needs_more_information
textTemplates.text:
Returned for input

Returned to you for input

Application {!$Record.Name} · {!$Record.Organization_Name__c}

 

Hi {!$Record.WG_Validator_Name__c},

The reviewer has returned this application to you. They need more information before they can finish the evaluation.

What the reviewer asked for

{!Get_Proposal_Review.Reviewer_Return_Comment__c}

Application round: {!$Record.Submission_Round__c}

Two steps to close this:

  1. Check whether the answer is already in the application. If it is, point the reviewer to the page and question where it sits.
  2. If it is genuinely missing, return the application to the applicant and ask for that detail.

The applicant sees no change until you return it to them. Please act by {!$Record.Due_Date__c}, so the evaluation is not held up.

Open the application

Wadhwani Grants Platform

Wadhwani Grants, the grant-making arm of the Wadhwani Foundation.

An automated notice from the Wadhwani Grants Platform. The applicant is not copied on this email, and replies to this address are not read.
